data.one_liner: SDK for capturing ID documents, selfies and performing face matches in Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a ready‑made KYC workflow that captures ID card images and user selfies, performs face matching and returns a result object. It handles native camera preview, injection checks and cross‑platform integration.
use_when: You need a quick, out‑of‑the‑box KYC flow with document and face capture
You want to avoid building custom camera and OCR logic
You need built‑in injection checks for device security
avoid_when: You require a fully custom UI or want to control every camera frame
You are targeting platforms other than Android/iOS
You need to integrate with a backend that already handles document capture
strengths: Supports injection checks and emulator detection
data.setup_notes: Android: enable AndroidX, set minSdk 21, add maven repo, enable multidex. iOS: run pod install, add camera permission to Info.plist. No build_runner needed.
